results.title: Impulse seed theorem
results.scope: Complex l2 impulse expansion, finite-support identity, unitary shifts and dense shift-generated span.

results.title: Polyphase projector theorem
results.scope: Bounded orthogonal residue projectors on complex l2.

results.title: Analysis–synthesis identity
results.scope: Signed integer polyphase linear isometry; channels represented by joint l2 coordinates.

results.title: Exact nested refinement
results.scope: Literal divisible-modulus bounded projector refinement.

results.title: Exact FIR polyphase transfer law
results.scope: Time-domain transfer for every bilateral sequence; channel z-transform identity for z nonzero wherever each weighted input series is summable.

results.title: Perfect-reconstruction criterion
results.scope: Concrete finite Laurent/FIR banks on every bilateral sequence, faithful matrix/operator correspondence, gain and channel delay; original-sample delay is N*d. Arbitrary scalar-matrix criterion is also retained in FiniteTransforms.

results.title: Haar energy identity
results.scope: Literal interleaved input and normalized low/detail channels in complex l2.

results.title: Exact lifting reconstruction
results.scope: Pairwise predict/update inverse and determinant one, with both flat finite-signal inverse laws.

results.title: Wavelet-packet reconstruction and energy
results.scope: All finite depths of literal Haar packet operators; sums of true Hilbert adjoints reconstruct, and packet norms preserve energy.

results.title: Exact known-edge theorem
results.scope: Exact known-edge cancellation in arbitrary seminormed additive groups.

results.title: Several exact edge packets
results.scope: Finite families of exactly retained jump packets.

results.title: Packet perturbation bound
results.scope: Measurable scalar masks in arbitrary measure spaces; extended finite-p norms, and pointwise plus essential supremum bounds. Finite mask and symmetric-difference measures yield the finite real-valued statement.

results.title: Exact synthesis from every complete pruning
results.scope: Literal finite node sums over covering antichains, with exact operator and applied-signal synthesis under the manuscript conservation hypotheses.

results.title: Finite globally optimal stable selector
results.scope: Named nonadditive representation/leakage/complexity criterion; attained positive gap when competitors exist, uniform perturbation stability, and singleton case. Every pruning preserves synthesis.

results.title: Dynamic-programming best packet basis
results.scope: Cached bottom-up evaluator equals the global selector; stop on ties. One comparison per internal node; at most 3*node-count unit operations for visits/comparisons/value additions with node costs supplied. Not a Lean runtime or scalar-cost evaluation bound.

results.title: Local perturbation certificate
results.scope: Exact maximum antichain error envelope and strict-gap stability; probability transfer from a joint local-error event is proved in PruningAlgorithm.

results.title: Cyclic product law
results.scope: Formal power-series cyclic product and literal q-tuple power formula over commutative semirings, including q=0. Analytic interpretations apply on their convergence domains; no arbitrary divergent evaluation is asserted.

results.title: Polyphase Möbius action
results.scope: Explicit exponential root of unity and modulo-N action on the projective quotient of nonzero homogeneous pairs; Cayley conjugacy and the finite-chart formula.

results.title: Impedance–admittance is the two-phase split
results.scope: The N=2 phase is -1; its action swaps homogeneous coordinates, exchanging zero/infinity and giving inverse impedance on the nonzero chart.

results.title: Dyadic–odd packet factorization
results.scope: Signed integer CRT residue masks and dyadic-odd factorization.
